info.title: Pickable Public Scan API
info.summary: Read public website scan results and request a scan of a public domain.
info.description: Pickable is a public website-analysis demo. Scan jobs are asynchronous. Public read routes expose scan history, statuses, reports, raw source results, and preview metadata without identity or confidentiality. POST /api/scans requires either the process CSRF token returned by GET /api/config or an operator-issued bearer key configured with PICKABLE_AGENT_API_KEY. MCP uses stateless JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP. The documented report and scores are source observations, not proof of a real agent journey or guaranteed growth.

servers.description: Public Pickable demo. The server substitutes PICKABLE_PUBLIC_URL when serving this document.

tags.name: Scans
tags.description: Asynchronous scans of public domain names. Read endpoints are public.

get.summary: Get scan mode and CSRF token
get.description: Returns the current demo/live mode and a process-scoped anti-CSRF token. The token is not user identity and does not restrict or protect public read endpoints.

200.description: Current service mode and scan-creation CSRF token.

get.description: Returns a lightweight indication that the HTTP service is responding and identifies its current mode. It is not a guarantee that external scan providers are available.
Returns stored scan summary metadata in reverse creation order. This read endpoint is public and does not provide caller identity or confidentiality.

post.summary: Create an asynchronous scan of a public domain
post.description: Accepts exactly one JSON object property, domain. The value may be a bare public domain or an http(s) root URL; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and Unicode domains are normalized with IDNA. Ports, credentials, non-root paths, query strings, fragments, IP literals, localhost, and private or reserved destinations are rejected. Send either X-CSRF-Token obtained from GET /api/config or an operator-issued Authorization Bearer key configured with PICKABLE_AGENT_API_KEY. Successful admission creates a real asynchronous scan and returns its job_id. A 429 response includes Retry-After.

requestBody.description: A UTF-8 JSON object with exactly one property. Maximum encoded body size is 2,048 bytes.

202.description: Scan accepted. Use the returned job_id to poll scan status.

400.description: Missing or malformed Content-Length, invalid UTF-8/JSON, or invalid domain/body shape.

403.description: Host or Origin is disallowed, or neither a valid CSRF token nor a configured valid bearer key was supplied.

408.description: The request body did not arrive before the read timeout.

429.description: The bounded queue or per-peer/global scan rate limit is full. Respect Retry-After before retrying.

get.summary: Read scan status and current report
get.description: Returns the current job state and source states. A normalized report may be null before any source report is available and may be partial while sources remain pending. Read access is public.

200.description: Scan status and optional partial or complete report.

get.description: Returns the normalized report when one exists. A 404 means that the scan is unknown or no report is available yet; check GET /api/scans/{job_id} for current status. An available report can still contain partial source coverage while the job is running.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source identifier for the original report.

get.description: Returns the original JSON document stored for the requested source when it is available. Read access is public.

schema.description: Source-owned JSON structure; its internal schema depends on the provider.

get.description: Returns preview fields collected for the scanned domain, or a null preview when none is available. Read access is public.
Pickable is stateless and does not open server-sent event streams. GET /mcp returns HTTP 405 with Allow: POST. Use POST for JSON-RPC messages.

post.description: Implements stateless MCP Streamable HTTP using one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per POST. The request Accept header must include both application/json and text/event-stream, while Pickable responds with application/json only. Initialize with 2025-03-26 or 2025-06-18; the initialization response selects the negotiated version. Send MCP-Protocol-Version with that value on subsequent POST requests. A notification such as notifications/initialized receives HTTP 202 with an empty response body. The default tools are describe_pickable, list_scans, and get_scan_report. start_website_scan is advertised only when PICKABLE_MCP_SCAN_ENABLED=1 and PICKABLE_AGENT_API_KEY are both configured; its call requires the configured bearer key. Public read tools expose public scan information.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Omit on initialize. On later requests, send the version selected in the initialize response. If omitted on a later request, Pickable treats the caller as a 2025-03-26 client.

requestBody.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 request or notification. Maximum body size is 32 KiB. Initialize requires protocolVersion, capabilities, and clientInfo. Tool calls use tools/call with name and arguments.

200.description: A JSON-RPC result or protocol error. Response includes MCP-Protocol-Version with the negotiated version.

202.description: Notification accepted. The response has an empty body and Content-Length: 0.

400.description: Malformed message, unsupported protocol-version header, or invalid JSON request envelope.

401.description: The optional scan-start tool was enabled but the configured bearer key was absent or invalid.

405.description: SSE is unsupported. Allow contains POST.

406.description: Accept did not include both application/json and text/event-stream.

408.description: The JSON request body timed out while being read.

413.description: The JSON request body exceeds 32 KiB.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Obtain the process-scoped anti-CSRF token from GET /api/config. This does not identify a user and does not protect public GET endpoints.

AgentBearer.description: Optional operator-issued shared key from PICKABLE_AGENT_API_KEY. Valid only for scan creation. The key must be at least 32 ASCII characters with no whitespace. This is not OAuth or user identity.

JobId.name: job_id
JobId.description: Identifier returned by scan creation or a public scan list.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying scan creation.

HostOrOriginRejected.description: Host or supplied Origin does not match the service's allowed host/origin configuration.

NotFound.description: The scan does not exist, the requested source report is unavailable, or no normalized report exists yet.

csrf_token.description: Process-scoped anti-CSRF token for scan creation.

domain.description: Public domain input. Accepts a bare domain such as example.com or an http:// or https:// root URL such as https://example.com/. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Unicode domains are accepted and normalized with IDNA. Ports, credentials, non-root paths, query strings, fragments, IP literals, localhost, and private or reserved destinations are rejected.

report.description: Null before any source report is available; may be partial while the scan is pending or running.

params.description: Method parameters. initialize requires protocolVersion, capabilities, and clientInfo; tools/call requires name.

protocolVersion.description: Request 2025-03-26 or 2025-06-18. Unsupported values are negotiated to a supported version.

oneOf.description: Empty arguments for describe_pickable and list_scans.

domain.description: Public domain or http(s) root URL; private and reserved destinations are rejected.

oneOf.description: Arguments for start_website_scan only when the operator has enabled that tool.

name.description: start_website_scan is advertised only when enabled by the server operator.

isError.description: True for tool execution failures, including invalid domain and queue/rate-limit errors returned over HTTP 200.

structuredContent.description: Structured content is present for successful calls using protocol version 2025-06-18. It is omitted for tool errors.
